title: Peer-to-peer lending
summary: Cut out the bank: individuals lend directly to borrowers.
whyTempting: Banks' spread looks like pure waste to remove.
whyItFails: Adverse selection. The best borrowers get bank loans; you get the rest. Credit cycles. Losses spike in downturns and lenders flee. Regulation and capital. You end up becoming a bank anyway.
whatWouldChange: Better underwriting data, but the structural issues remain largely unchanged.

attempts.outcome: Hit with an SEC cease-and-desist order in 2008
Closed its peer-to-peer business to focus on banking

attempts.notes: Bought Radius Bank and ceased operating as a peer-to-peer lender in December 2020.

attempts.outcome: Sold to Metro Bank for £2.5 million; investor accounts closed
attempts.notes: Plenti to reflect a broader focus on consumer, automotive, and renewable energy (green) loans rather than just peer-to-peer lending.
